4 Bedroom House · Prime Jesmond Location · 2 Bathrooms

Acorn Properties are delighted to re-introduce to the market this popular student property available next September. This large flat comfortably accommodates with four large double bedrooms, large kitchen and two bathrooms. The house's great location also puts you only a stones throw from Osborne Road and Jesmond's local amenities. Viewing is highly advised. To arrange, call My Property Box today and speak to the Lettings team.
